game_title: Divide Or Floor – Lava River Crossing Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing, a river of molten rock: the volcanologist must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Divide Or Floor: Pick / or // to split heat shields evenly among allies without leaving fractions.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing: a river of molten rock
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava River Crossing, repeat each round: Pick / or // to split heat shields evenly among allies without leaving fractions. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the volcanologist ahead. Then check the share value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the forge anvil by solving code steps involving share that move the volcanologist forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.5).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the forge anvil first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Divide Or Floor
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Divide Or Floor' (Week 2 slot 4), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Lava River Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how share changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Lava River Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.5).
